name: Mahou Shoujo Ixia
source:
Ixia is a half-angel, half-human magical girl. Her duty was to seal the soul of the devil. Her childhood friend, the protagonist, was helping her but the devil was accidentally sealed inside of him! To purify his soul, sex is required, but the devil is only interested in virgins. In order to completely purify the soul of the devil, Ixia magically regrows her hymen after every time she and the protagonist have sex.

[translated from [url=http://www.softpal.co.jp/erectlip/product02.html]official page[/url]]
translation:
伊克希娅是一名半天使、半人类的魔法少女，职责是封印恶魔的灵魂。她的青梅竹马，也就是主人公，一直在旁协助，可恶魔竟意外被封印进了他的体内！净化他的灵魂必须通过性交，但恶魔只对处女感兴趣。为了彻底净化恶魔之魂，伊克希娅每次与主人公发生关系后，都会用魔法令处女膜重新生长。
